blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: Moxy Hotels commercial distribution rides Marriott Bonvoy direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Accessible lifestyle select-service: playful social public space, efficient rooms, and nightlife-adjacent energy for younger and value-conscious travelers. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: Commercial Differentiator
blocks.body: Versus AC Hotels' European contemporary select-service, Moxy leans budget lifestyle intensity; versus W, it avoids luxury lifestyle capital while still riding Bonvoy.

blocks.body: Brand.com / Marriott Bonvoy app · major OTAs · GDS · metasearch (where active for the hotel)

blocks.title: Owner Lens
blocks.body: Model Moxy Hotels contribution after loyalty chargebacks, preferred-agency commissions, and local competitive set reality—not headline RevPAR alone.

blocks.title: Distribution & Channel Mix
blocks.body: Parent central reservations, Marriott Bonvoy app, and designated online channels—confirm commission structures and rate parity obligations in the current agreement exhibit.

blocks.title: Revenue Management
blocks.body: Parent revenue tools and Marriott Bonvoy demand signals support pricing experiments; owners still need property-level strategy for this brand's product promise.

blocks.title: Digital Marketing & Performance Media
blocks.body: Paid and owned media templates at portfolio scale, with creative that must still feel brand- and hotel-specific rather than generic parent advertising.

blocks.title: Corporate, SME & Group Pull
blocks.body: Contracted travelers, small meetings, and negotiated programs where Moxy Hotels fits the account's brand ladder.

blocks.title: Owner Perception Risk
blocks.body: Owners sometimes expect lifestyle lightness without systems cost; Moxy Hotels still carries parent systems, Marriott Bonvoy economics, and brand QA. Align IC expectations early.

blocks.title: Marriott Bonvoy
blocks.body: Moxy Hotels participates in Marriott Bonvoy. Members earn and redeem points and receive Elite recognition across participating sister brands. Confirm current tier names and earn rules on the official program site before IC.

blocks.title: Loyalty
blocks.body: Marriott Bonvoy at Moxy Hotels

blocks.title: Earn
blocks.body: Guests earn Marriott Bonvoy points on qualifying stays at Moxy Hotels. Elite members may receive enhanced earn and recognition benefits per current program rules.

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the Marriott Bonvoy portfolio, including Moxy Hotels, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Elite Recognition
blocks.body: Elite status recognition (upgrades, late checkout, lounge access where offered) applies per property capability—delivery varies by hotel.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.body: Marriott Bonvoy partnerships, co-branded cards, and bonus campaigns expand the loyalty halo; Moxy Hotels stays remain the property-level earn/redeem node.

blocks.title: Owner Lens
blocks.body: Marriott Bonvoy drives distribution and repeat demand but adds loyalty chargebacks and program economics. Underwrite net contribution after loyalty—not membership vanity metrics.

blocks.title: P&L Implications
blocks.body: Loyalty assessments and program contribution affect net rooms revenue. Use current agreement exhibits; do not invent undisclosed rates.

blocks.title: Operating Implications
blocks.body: Front desk and systems must support Marriott Bonvoy enrollment, Elite recognition, and redemption stays without erasing the brand's guest experience.

blocks.title: Systems Implications
blocks.body: Parent property and reservation systems integration is required for Marriott Bonvoy participation—budget cutover and training in the conversion plan.

blocks.title: Repeat Guest Capture
blocks.body: Marriott Bonvoy earn and recognition increase the probability of repeat Moxy stays where the hotel already competes on product fit—not on a standardized prototype alone.

blocks.title: Direct Channel & Member Pricing
blocks.body: Bonvoy member rates and Marriott direct paths help Moxy hotels defend contribution against high-commission intermediaries while keeping brand positioning intact.

blocks.title: Elite Member Value
blocks.body: Elite recognition (upgrades where available, late checkout, milestone rewards) supports contribution at Moxy; amenity delivery still varies by property capability.

blocks.title: Cross-Brand Traveler Flow
blocks.body: Bonvoy recognition across Marriott sister brands matters for guests who split stays within the network—Moxy remains the brand-specific node inside that earn/redeem graph.

blocks.title: Cobrand & Payment Scale
blocks.body: Bonvoy co-branded cards, Moments, and bonus-point campaigns lift acquisition; model hotel-level contribution after loyalty chargebacks—not portfolio vanity metrics.

blocks.title: Corporate & Small Meetings
blocks.body: Marriott account linkage and negotiated transient patterns support midweek compression where corporate and SMERF mix fits the Moxy asset—confirm for this hotel's source markets.

blocks.title: To Join
blocks.body: Moxy application, royalty, program contribution, and Bonvoy assessments — confirm current Marriott franchise / development fee exhibits. Amounts are not staged without a verified disclosure.
blocks.source: Marriott development materials — Moxy Hotels positioning (public)

blocks.title: To Operate
blocks.body: Steady-state royalty, program contribution, and Marriott Bonvoy loyalty assessments — confirm definitions, bases, and current percentages in the live disclosure exhibit for Moxy Hotels. Do not underwrite from peer rumor.
blocks.source: Marriott development materials — Moxy Hotels positioning (public)

blocks.title: When Things Change
blocks.body: Renewal PIP; conversion PIP revisions; transfer / change-of-ownership fees; termination-related obligations; owner-funded reserves—triggered at renewal, repositioning, or exit. Confirm liquidated damages and transfer mechanics in the current agreement.
blocks.source: Marriott development materials — Moxy Hotels positioning (public)

blocks.title: Fee Variability
blocks.body: Initial vs conversion paths differ; program contribution and loyalty assessments may change by year under agreement terms. Lock the fee exhibit before IC—never extrapolate from a peer hotel's rumor. Geography note: Confirm current Marriott franchise / development disclosure for Moxy

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add Marriott Bonvoy: retain Moxy Hotels's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Accessible lifestyle select-service: playful social public space, efficient rooms, and nightlife-adjacent energy for younger and value-conscious travelers.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.

blocks.title: Urban Lifestyle on a Select-Service Stack
blocks.body: Dense urban sites where social lobby programming and accessible rates can outperform conventional limited-service without full-service F&B capital.

blocks.title: Entertainment & Nightlife Corridors
blocks.body: Districts where evening energy and social public space are the demand story—underwrite noise, F&B lite, and neighbor mix before assuming Moxy fit.

blocks.title: Airport & Gateway Value Lifestyle
blocks.body: Gateway and airport-adjacent assets seeking lifestyle differentiation at accessible price points versus AC, Aloft, or hard limited-service flags.

blocks.title: Gateway Urban
blocks.body: Strong Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Moxy Hotels fits gateway urban demand where parent distribution and loyalty support transient and corporate mixes—underwrite city competitive set.

blocks.title: Conversion & Repositioning
blocks.body: Strong Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Conversion / repositioning is a core owner path when independents seek Moxy Hotels affiliation and loyalty access—underwrite PIP scope first.

blocks.title: Corporate-Led Urban
blocks.body: Moderate Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Corporate-led urban accounts can pull Moxy Hotels when the product matches account brand ladders; confirm negotiated rates before assuming contracted volume.

blocks.title: Regional & Secondary Markets
blocks.body: Moderate Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Secondary markets work when Moxy Hotels's product and fee load clear local ADR reality; diligence source-market seasonality.

blocks.title: Highway & Interstate Transient
blocks.body: Not a Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Highway / interstate limited-service economics generally sit outside Moxy Hotels's product and fee structure.

blocks.title: Resort & Coastal Leisure
blocks.body: Limited Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Leisure resort fit depends on whether Moxy Hotels's service model matches resort operating complexity.

before.body: Moxy Hotels is a playful social lifestyle-select Marriott brand within Marriott International. For owners, the affiliation case is compact rooms, social public space, urban and lifestyle demand, operating implications, and Marriott Bonvoy distribution. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among AC Hotels by Marriott, Aloft, Autograph Collection.
